item.title: Government bans Wingo gaming app after scam SMS sent from users’ phones
item.description: The Indian government has taken major action against the Wingo gaming app after it was found sending fake SMS messages from users’ phones without their knowledge. The Ministry of Home Affairs blocked the app’s servers, banned related Telegram channels and YouTube videos to prevent further frauds.
